question: Padma Vibhushan awardee Kathak dancer and choreographer, Birju Maharaj belonged to which of the following Gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalka- Bindadin**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Padma Vibhushan awardee Kathak dancer and choreographer Pandit Birju Maharaj belonged to the Kalka-Bindadin gharana of Lucknow
 
• He received several prestigious honors, including the **Padma Vibhushan (1986)**, the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**, the **Kalidas Samman**, the **National Film Award (2012)**, and the **Filmfare Award (2016)**.
 
• Apart from his classical performances, he also choreographed dances for Bollywood films like **Umrao Jaan**, **Dedh Ishqiya**, and **Bajirao Mastani**, blending traditional Kathak with cinematic expression.
 
• Born into a well-known Kathak dancing family, he carried forward the legacy of his lineage and became an icon in Indian classical dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lucknow Gharana:**

 
 
• **Focuses on graceful and subtle movements** with a strong emphasis on storytelling and expression.
 
• Known for its beautiful spins (chakkars) and expressive mudras (hand gestures).
 
 
 
• **Jaipur Gharana:**
 
 
• Known for its complex and rapid footwork, with an emphasis on rhythm and speed.
 
• Strongly rooted in pure dance and intricate patterns.
 
 
 
• **Benaras Gharana:**
 
 
• Known for its vigorous footwork and energetic performance style, incorporating elements of drama and narration.
